title: Global Risk Clocks
summary: Speculative pressure scores refreshed from dated public-source drops. These remain evidence-boundary signals, not predictions or claims of certainty.
homepageRule: Only clocks at 90 percent or above may surface on the homepage. Alerts may surface only when active, source-linked and within their active window.
evidenceRule: Use dated public signals only. Keep speculation labelled. Do not repeat drop text inside signal strings; attach drops through latestDrops.

clocks.title: WWIII Escalation Clock
clocks.signals: Conflict pressure remains elevated through Ukraine/Russia, Middle East flashpoints, cyber operations, sanctions and nuclear rhetoric. Current July refresh did not add a new direct kinetic-escalation source, so the score is held rather than raised.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise only with source-linked troop movement, emergency law, cyber/kinetic escalation, sanctions shock, nuclear posture change or official military statement.

clocks.title: AI Breakout Clock
clocks.signals: The EU AI Act is now an active implementation lane: GPAI obligations are already active, transparency rules are due in August 2026, and high-risk AI obligations continue through 2027–2028. The Commission also lists July 2026 cybersecurity-and-AI work, keeping the AI/cyber governance lane high.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on official enforcement action, frontier-model incident, national-security model review, cybersecurity AI testing platform, high-risk AI deployment mandate, or AI Office action.

clocks.title: Surveillance State Clock
clocks.signals: Digital ID, AI governance, platform transparency, payment identity, public/private security integration and health-emergency governance remain active. July 2026 refresh adds AI Act implementation, EUDI wallet rollout/oversharing risk, WHO Pandemic Agreement/PABS implementation, and digital euro legislation/readiness signals.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on mandatory identity use for major services, identity-linked payment rails, biometric travel expansion, health-pass integration, platform enforcement tied to state rules, or legal mandate.

clocks.title: Financial Reset Clock
clocks.signals: Debt stress, private payment dependence, tokenised settlement, stablecoin competition, CBDC planning and digital-euro legislation keep the financial-system lane elevated. July refresh raises the source quality through official ECB digital euro timeline language.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on CBDC legislation, central-bank pilot, banking stress, cash restriction, settlement outage, stablecoin policy shock, or identity-linked payment requirement.

clocks.title: CBDC Rollout Clock
clocks.signals: The digital euro remains the strongest current CBDC route: ECB says the Eurosystem aims to be ready for possible first issuance in 2029 if legislation is adopted in 2026. This connects public digital money, wallet infrastructure, privacy design and sovereign payment-rail policy.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on legislation, pilot launch, bank/wallet implementation rules, holding limits, offline design, privacy enforcement, or merchant acceptance requirements.

clocks.title: Cyber Blackout Clock
clocks.signals: Cyber risk remains elevated through AI-enabled misuse, infrastructure dependency, banking/payment concentration, state cyber operations and EU AI/cyber resilience planning. July refresh links cyber risk more strongly to AI governance rather than a specific blackout event.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on official incident, sector outage, bank/payment disruption, grid or telecom incident, agency warning, or confirmed AI-enabled cyber capability.

clocks.title: Alien Disclosure Clock
clocks.signals: UAP hearings, whistleblower claims, NASA/DoD statements and anomalous-object reporting remain watch-level. No July 2026 source in this refresh warrants escalation.

clocks.title: Pandemic / Biosecurity Clock
clocks.signals: WHO states the Pandemic Agreement was adopted in May 2025, but the PABS annex remains the key next step before signing/ratification. July 2026 IGWG meetings keep the health-governance implementation lane active without implying direct WHO control over national measures.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on PABS annex text, ratification milestones, national implementation law, health credential integration, emergency procurement, or official supply-chain/logistics mechanism.

clocks.title: Civil Unrest Clock
clocks.signals: Civil-stability pressure remains elevated through elections, migration, economic strain, war protest cycles, platform/speech rules and emergency politics. July refresh adds no single acute civil-unrest trigger, so the score is held lower than homepage threshold.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on emergency law, mass protest, platform/payment access event, migration shock, policing escalation, or court-confirmed unrest trigger.

clocks.title: Food System Stress Clock
clocks.signals: Food and land-system stress remains elevated through conflict, weather, aid funding, water scarcity, input prices and supply-chain concentration. No new July source was attached in this refresh.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on official food-security warning, export ban, crop failure, rationing, traceability mandate, fertilizer shock, water restriction, or supply-chain disruption.

clocks.title: Energy Shock Clock
clocks.signals: Energy pressure remains elevated through chokepoints, LNG/refinery risks, sanctions, cyber risk and grid strain. No new July source in this refresh justifies escalation.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise on chokepoint closure, refinery/energy infrastructure attack, grid event, LNG disruption, sanctions shock or official emergency measure.

clocks.title: Machine Convergence
clocks.signals: Composite convergence is rising through overlapping AI governance, digital identity wallets, CBDC readiness, health-governance data systems, platform regulation and cyber-security integration. This remains a composite editorial index, not a certainty claim.
clocks.timerUpdateRule: Raise when two or more lanes integrate: identity plus money, health plus travel, AI plus public services, payments plus speech/platform access, or security plus civilian infrastructure.

method: Classify the found item by tracker lane.
Attach source link, actor, date, jurisdiction, and record boundary.
Update linked clock notes and nextRoute to control-system-tracker.html when relevant.
Only raise homepageEligible when score is 90 or above and the signal is time-sensitive.
Never update a timer from rumor alone. Use rumor only as an open-source lead.

evidenceLevels.5: Integration across two or more systems

policyConvergence.boundary: Timer movement is an editorial pressure signal, not a prediction or claim of certainty. Every timer update should be linked to a source class, evidence level, date, actor, jurisdiction, and record boundary.
